title: Coast Guard rescues hiker missing for 5 days in Southern Oregon
description:
A Coast Guard MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew from Sector North Bend rescued a missing hiker in the Rogue River-Siskiyou National Forest, June 14, 2017.

The Coast Guard was asked to support search efforts by Oregon state and Josephine County search and rescue coordinators to find the hiker who had been missing for 5 days.

U.S. Coast Guard video by Sector North Bend
